meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：周巽光、璽恩、曹之懿、湯國維、鄭牧德
中譯英：王建玫

lines.a: 我想聽祢聲音 渴望貼近祢的心
lines.b: I long to hear Your voice, to draw in close and know Your heart

lines.a: 我在尋找有種平靜 在祢聲音裡
lines.b: I'm searching for that quiet peace found where You are

lines.a: 我以為我需要 一個偉大的經歷
lines.b: I thought I had to see a mighty wonder from the skies

lines.a: 祢卻輕聲向我訴說 孩子我愛你
lines.b: But You spoke gently to my soul: “Child, you are Mine”

lines.a: 定睛於祢天父 來到祢的身邊
lines.b: I lift my eyes to You, Lord, and come before Your throne

lines.a: 讓我專心聆聽 我與祢面對面
lines.b: Help me be still and listen — just You and me alone

lines.a: 側耳傾聽 主祢微小聲音
lines.b: I will lean in, to hear Your whisper near

lines.a: 在祢腳前安靜 祢的話語是生命
lines.b: At Your feet I rest, Your Word brings life and clears my fear

lines.a: 祢靈讓我甦醒 我渴慕祢
lines.b: Spirit, breathe new life in me — I long for Thee

lines.a: 沉浸在祢懷裡 我靈安息
lines.b: Wrapped within Your arms of peace, my soul finds ease
In awe, I bow before Thee
